explanation.en: “All members can bring a guest for £5” (A) and “Members can change their membership type once every three months” (C). Classes (B) are not in swim-only, the pool “at any time” (E) is not off-peak, and £32 (D) is standard only.
explanation.kk: «All members can bring a guest for £5» (A) және «Members can change their membership type once every three months» (C). Сабақтар (B) swim-only түріне кірмейді, бассейн «at any time» (E) off-peak үшін жабық, £32 (D) — тек standard.
explanation.ru: «All members can bring a guest for £5» (A) и «Members can change their membership type once every three months» (C). Классы (B) не входят в swim-only, бассейн «at any time» (E) недоступен off-peak, £32 (D) — только standard.

explanation.en: Members “will move to standard membership automatically unless they choose a different option by 20 September” → D. Anyone who does nothing moves to standard; losing membership or paying extra is not mentioned.
explanation.kk: Мүшелер «will move to standard membership automatically unless they choose a different option by 20 September» → D. Ештеңе таңдамағандар өздігінен standard түріне ауысады; мүшелікті жоғалту мен қосымша төлем мәтінде жоқ.
explanation.ru: Участники «will move to standard membership automatically unless they choose a different option by 20 September» → D. Кто ничего не выбрал, автоматически переходит на standard; потери членства и доплаты в тексте нет.
